# Regression test for https://go.dev/issue/37552.
# A pattern with enough "/.." elements to back into a "..." wildcard
# must be rejected rather than silently cleaned to a different pattern.

cd parent/m/build

! go list .../..
stderr '^go: invalid pattern "\.\.\./\.\.": "\.\." element cancels "\.\.\." wildcard$'
! stdout .

! go list .../../
stderr '^go: invalid pattern "\.\.\./\.\./": "\.\." element cancels "\.\.\." wildcard$'
! stdout .

! go list .../../../
stderr '^go: invalid pattern "\.\.\./\.\./\.\./": "\.\." element cancels "\.\.\." wildcard$'
! stdout .

! go list ./.../..
stderr '^go: invalid pattern "\./\.\.\./\.\.": "\.\." element cancels "\.\.\." wildcard$'

! go list a/.../../../..
stderr '^go: invalid pattern "a/\.\.\./\.\./\.\./\.\.": "\.\." element cancels "\.\.\." wildcard$'

! go list example.com/m/.../..
stderr '^go: invalid pattern "example\.com/m/\.\.\./\.\.": "\.\." element cancels "\.\.\." wildcard$'

! go list std/.../..
stderr '^go: invalid pattern "std/\.\.\./\.\.": "\.\." element cancels "\.\.\." wildcard$'

! go list $WORK/gopath/src/parent/m/.../..
stderr 'invalid pattern ".*/parent/m/\.\.\./\.\.": "\.\." element cancels "\.\.\." wildcard$'

! go build ../a/.../..
stderr '^go: invalid pattern "\.\./a/\.\.\./\.\.": "\.\." element cancels "\.\.\." wildcard$'

! go get example.com/m/.../..@latest
stderr '^go: invalid pattern "example\.com/m/\.\.\./\.\.@latest": "\.\." element cancels "\.\.\." wildcard$'

# A ".." that does not back into a "..." wildcard is still allowed.
go list example.com/m/.../b/..
stdout '^example.com/m$'
stdout '^example.com/m/a$'
stdout '^example.com/m/b$'

go list ../...
stdout '^example.com/m$'
stdout '^example.com/m/a$'
stdout '^example.com/m/b$'

go list ../a/...
stdout '^example.com/m/a$'
! stdout '^example.com/m/b$'

go list .../a
stdout '^example.com/m/a$'
! stdout '^example.com/m/b$'

go list example.com/m/...
stdout '^example.com/m$'
stdout '^example.com/m/a$'
stdout '^example.com/m/b$'

go list std
stdout '^fmt$'

go list cmd/...
stdout '^cmd/go$'

cd ..
go list ./...
stdout '^example.com/m$'
stdout '^example.com/m/a$'
stdout '^example.com/m/b$'

go list ./a/../b/...
stdout '^example.com/m/b$'
! stdout '^example.com/m/a$'

-- parent/go.mod --
module example.com/parent

go 1.24
-- parent/parent.go --
package parent
-- parent/m/go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.24
-- parent/m/m.go --
package m
-- parent/m/a/a.go --
package a
-- parent/m/b/b.go --
package b
-- parent/m/build/README --
Not a package.
